detailed_descriptions.en: Tap the balls to shoot them toward the goal balls that score will earn you sweet cash. Use your earnings to unlock better balls and powerful upgrades. The more balls you have on the field, the more goals you can score! Invest in skills to boost your income and watch your balls fill the pitch while your wallet fills with gold. Stop clicking and start reigning! Why do the heavy lifting yourself when your "Helpers" can dominate the field for you? Build your ultimate squad of automated strikers and watch your empire grow while you relax. These relentless goal machines don't need breaks or motivation; they are engineered for one thing only: maximizing your profit. Master the Skill Tree and start fresh with power! Unlock game-changing abilities, choose your path, and reset your progress to become even stronger. Each restart grants you permanent bonuses that stack with every rebirth. Will you focus on speed, power, or automation? The choice is yours and every reset makes you unstoppable! Unlock Auto-Shooters, your tireless mechanical teammates who score goals and rake in cash for you. Turn your run into a full-blown money-printing machine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and watch the beautiful game unfold. As you prosper, you'll unlock upgrades that twist the game in your favor: • Boosted ball types – From rubber to classic to golden, each more valuable than the last • Faster automation – Let your players do the work while you count the cash • New skills and abilities – 14 unique upgrades that reshape your strategy But power always comes with choices. Some skills offer steady income… others demand massive investment for explosive returns. Will you play it safe with rubber balls or gamble everything on golden glory? When you're ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather powerful bonuses, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own football empire: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos. Goal Idle is a dangerously satisfying progression game, where every goal is a little dopamine hit, every upgrade is a strategic choice, and every run is one lucky streak away from becoming a football legend!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Tap the balls to shoot them toward the goal balls that score will earn you sweet cash. Use your earnings to unlock better balls and powerful upgrades. The more balls you have on the field, the more goals you can score! Invest in skills to boost your income and watch your balls fill the pitch while your wallet fills with gold.

Stop clicking and start reigning! Why do the heavy lifting yourself when your "Helpers" can dominate the field for you? Build your ultimate squad of automated strikers and watch your empire grow while you relax. These relentless goal machines don't need breaks or motivation; they are engineered for one thing only: maximizing your profit.

Master the Skill Tree and start fresh with power! Unlock game-changing abilities, choose your path, and reset your progress to become even stronger. Each restart grants you permanent bonuses that stack with every rebirth. Will you focus on speed, power, or automation? The choice is yours and every reset makes you unstoppable!


Unlock Auto-Shooters, your tireless mechanical teammates who score goals and rake in cash for you. Turn your run into a full-blown money-printing machine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and watch the beautiful game unfold.

As you prosper, you'll unlock upgrades that twist the game in your favor:

• Boosted ball types – From rubber to classic to golden, each more valuable than the last

• Faster automation – Let your players do the work while you count the cash

• New skills and abilities – 14 unique upgrades that reshape your strategy

But power always comes with choices. Some skills offer steady income… others demand massive investment for explosive returns. Will you play it safe with rubber balls or gamble everything on golden glory?

When you're ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather powerful bonuses, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own football empire: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Goal Idle is a dangerously satisfying progression game, where every goal is a little dopamine hit, every upgrade is a strategic choice, and every run is one lucky streak away from becoming a football legend!
